name: study-latex
description: Draws inline and display TeX math in Claude's replies in the Claude desktop app's Code tab, and on Windows with MiKTeX compiles TikZ figures; built for students who study with Claude. A fork of zaahiral/claude-latex 0.5.0

colorScheme.title: Math color
colorScheme.description: auto follows the system light or dark setting. Pick light or dark if the app's theme differs from the system's.

compileBlocks.title: Compile TikZ blocks (Windows, MiKTeX)
compileBlocks.description: Off by default. On, ```tikz code blocks in replies are compiled into figures with your local MiKTeX (latex and dvisvgm). Read the README's safety section before turning it on.
